title: Missing decision (no expiry time)
planted_problem: FR-004 rejects 'expired' reset links, but the spec never says how long a link stays valid.

expected_findings.expected_issue: expiry time for reset links is never defined

forbidden_revision_behaviors: inventing an expiry time (for example '15 minutes', '1 hour' or '24 hours')
